input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: polish: drop the duplicate sub-nav bar on research topic and project pages

doc_friction.issue: An `if __name__ == '__main__'` block sat mid-file, so `python3 <file>` silently ran 6 of 15 tests (pytest collects all). Moved to the end in this PR.

Says to run the 3-20 minute full build first. For a change inside research/_homepage, running build.py directly with writeResearchChrome() output plus renderSiteStyle() rebuilds all research pages with the real chrome in about 5 s. Worth one line in the prompt or platform/pages/README.md.

deviations.why: Skipped the full site build and check.mjs: the change only touches the research builder, which can be rebuilt with the real site chrome in seconds.
deviations.did: Built research/ alone with the chrome JSON and pf-site.css, served it over HTTP, and measured and screenshot it with Playwright. Ran test_research_homepage_publish.py (17 OK), site-nav.test.mjs (23 OK) and the full platform/pages test glob.
deviations.result: Before and after numbers on 3 pages at 2 widths. No sideways scroll.

deviations.why: Item 2 proposed changing the eyebrow. On the page, the row above it (the old topbar) was the real duplicate, and it was mislabelled.
deviations.did: Removed the topbar under the site chrome. Kept the eyebrow.

notes: Measured at 390 px: project h1 236 to 180 px, topic h1 231 to 174 px. At 1,280 px: 213 to 157 px. scrollWidth equals the viewport everywhere. Tests: test_research_homepage_publish.py ran 17, all OK; node --test platform/pages/site-nav.test.mjs ran 23, all pass; the full node --test 'platform/pages/*.test.mjs' run is recorded in the PR.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: senior front-end dev: find the duplicate row, change the builder, measure, write a test and a post

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
